description: Curated CI failure cases with the verdict an engineer would give: was the failure caused by the triggering commit? 'related' = caused by the change, 'unrelated' = not caused by it, 'uncertain' = the evidence genuinely cannot decide. Cases payflow-* reproduce the PayFlow demo repository's scripted failures (demo/README.md); the rest are written from common real-world CI failure patterns. Labels were written before the analyser was run on them.
